title: AI Took Over My Team
full_monologue: **I replaced my team of 5 with AI agents and it changed everything.** I used AI to automate tasks like project management, client communication, and data analysis. It’s faster, cheaper, and more accurate than humans. The AI agents work 24/7 without breaks or errors. I’m not saying humans are obsolete, but AI is a game-changer. What do you think? Can AI replace your team?
